content.value:
Our Statement of Performance Expectations 2024–2025 and our Statement of Intentions 2024–2028 have been published.

The Statement of Performance Expectations sets out the specific standards we have committed to achieve in the year starting from 1 July 2024 and our prospective financial statements. The Statement of Intentions sets out how we plan to deliver on our goals over the next four years and our immediate and future areas of strategic significance.
